hero.title: Your pantry, optimized with engineering
hero.subtitle: We’re building IngeniaFood — technology that scans your ingredients and designs the perfect recipe for your health and your schedule. Coming soon in Beta.

app.title: The Engineering of Your Nutrition
app.subtitle: IngeniaFood scans your ingredients and uses algorithms to deliver the perfect recipe with exact measurements. We’re in development to give you the best cooking experience.
app.cardBody: A real-time nutrition engine matches ingredients, times, and portions so you can decide better in seconds.

social.title: See progress in action
social.subtitle: Real content from our social channels — everyday ingredients turned into concrete results.
social.cta: Follow me for the Beta launch
social.note: There won’t be email sign-ups. Beta access will be released exclusively to my social followers on launch day. Don’t miss it.

benefits.title: What makes this guide unique?
benefits.item1Body: Recipes built for the clock. From stove to table in the time it takes water to boil.
benefits.item2Body: No specialty stores. We use what’s already in a standard fridge and pantry.
benefits.item3Body: No fine-dining techniques. Clear, direct steps without wrecking the whole kitchen.

guide.subtitle: I’ve picked my 10 favorite recipes for a light end to the day. Dinners optimized by IngeniaFood for record time, real ingredients, and 100% free of refined flours.
guide.bullet1: Recipes designed to be ready in under 15 minutes.
guide.bullet2: Simple ingredients you already have in your pantry.
guide.bullet3: Satisfying dinners that won’t leave you feeling heavy.
guide.imageAlt: Flourless wrap with egg, avocado, and arugula
